Declaration
web_form_fields.options:
This declaration is only for the students below 18 years of age.

I, as the parent/guardian, hereby declare and pledge to enroll my child in your summer school programme, as detailed on the PACE website of the National Law School of India University. I acknowledge that the programme will be conducted online, and I commit to ensuring my child's participation throughout the programme duration.

By affixing my signature to this declaration, I certify that I possess the legal authorization to register my child for the Foundations of Legal Education (FLE) course and that all information provided is truthful and comprehensive to the best of my understanding.

web_form_fields.label: I hereby consent to this declaration.
